decision: Temporary exception proposed only for a loopback-bound local assessment demonstration; not suitable as a general production security approval.
rationale: The Debian 13.7 image has 44 HIGH package/CVE entries representing eight unique CVEs, with no FixedVersion in this dated Trivy report. Keep the full scan; block every critical, changed, newly reported or fix-available finding and review regularly. Bandit B104 is intentional only where host-published ports remain on 127.0.0.1. No claim of non-exploitability.
required_controls: Keep Docker host-published app ports bound to 127.0.0.1 and do not expose this local demo to untrusted networks.
Use the non-root appuser in the container.
Rebuild with --pull and re-scan on every pipeline execution.
Review package advisories and remove this exception when a fix is available.
Do not use this exception as approval for public or real production deployment.
